vim.g.shoshinvim_config_root = config_root

local function load(name)
  if vim.g.shoshinvim_probe then return require('user_config.' .. name) end
  local ok, err = pcall(require, 'user_config.' .. name)
  if not ok then
    vim.schedule(function() vim.notify('ShoshinVim: ' .. name .. ' did not load: ' .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR) end)
  end
end

end

-- Generated by ShoshinVim. Put manual changes in user.lua.
-- Git change commands; shortcuts call these, so they work with gitsigns or mini.diff.
local function command(name, run, desc) vim.api.nvim_create_user_command(name, run, { desc = desc }) end
command("ShoshinHunkNext", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then if vim.wo.diff then vim.cmd.normal({ ']c', bang = true }) else m.nav_hunk('next') end end
end, "Next Git change")
command("ShoshinHunkPrev", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then if vim.wo.diff then vim.cmd.normal({ '[c', bang = true }) else m.nav_hunk('prev') end end
end, "Previous Git change")
command("ShoshinHunkPreview", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then m.preview_hunk() end
end, "Preview Git change")
command("ShoshinHunkStage", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then m.stage_hunk() end
end, "Stage Git change")
command("ShoshinHunkReset", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then m.reset_hunk() end
end, "Undo Git change")
command("ShoshinBlameLine", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then m.blame_line({ full = true }) end
end, "Blame this line")
command("ShoshinGitDiff", function()
  local ok, m = pcall(require, "gitsigns")
  if ok then m.diffthis() end
end, "Diff this file")

-- Generated by ShoshinVim. Put manual changes in user.lua.
-- The ShoshinVim wordmark on the start screen. In pixels, # is a filled cell.
local M = {
  pixels = {
    ".#####.##..##..####...#####.##..##.##.###..##.##...##.##.###..###",
    "##.....##..##.##..##.##.....##..##.##.####.##.##...##.##.########",
    ".####..######.##..##..####..######.##.##.####.##...##.##.##.##.##",
    "....##.##..##.##..##.....##.##..##.##.##..###..##.##..##.##....##",
    "#####..##..##..####..#####..##..##.##.##...##...###...##.##....##",
  },
  colors = {
    dark = { "#D27E99", "#C286A9", "#B08EB8", "#9A95C8", "#7E9CD8" },
    light = { "#B35B79", "#9F6081", "#88648A", "#6E6793", "#4D699B" },
  },
  mark = "S H O S H I N V I M", -- for windows narrower than min_width
  tagline = "A fresh mind. A focused workspace.",
  min_width = 69,
}

-- Filled cells are painted as background color, so the rows join without seams.
function M.highlight()
  for i, color in ipairs(M.colors[vim.o.background == 'light' and 'light' or 'dark']) do
    vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, 'ShoshinLogo' .. i, { bg = color })
  end
end

-- runs splits a row into runs of filled and empty cells: { { width, filled }, ... }.
function M.runs(row)
  local runs, i = {}, 1
  while i <= #row do
    local j = i
    while row:sub(j, j) == row:sub(i, i) do j = j + 1 end
    runs[#runs + 1] = { j - i, row:sub(i, i) == '#' }
    i = j
  end
  return runs
end

-- sections is the snacks.nvim dashboard header for a window this wide.
function M.sections(width)
  local tagline = { text = { M.tagline, hl = 'SnacksDashboardHeader' }, align = 'center', padding = 2 }
  if width < M.min_width then
    return { { text = { M.mark, hl = 'SnacksDashboardHeader' }, align = 'center', padding = 1 }, tagline }
  end
  local sections = {}
  for y, row in ipairs(M.pixels) do
    local text = {}
    for _, run in ipairs(M.runs(row)) do
      text[#text + 1] = { (' '):rep(run[1]), hl = run[2] and ('ShoshinLogo' .. y) or nil }
    end
    sections[#sections + 1] = { text = text, align = 'center', padding = y == #M.pixels and 1 or 0 }
  end
  sections[#sections + 1] = tagline
  return sections
end

if not vim.g.shoshinvim_probe then
  M.highlight()
  local group = vim.api.nvim_create_augroup('ShoshinLogo', { clear = true })
  vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('ColorScheme', { group = group, callback = M.highlight })
  vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('OptionSet', { group = group, pattern = 'background', callback = M.highlight })
end
return M

local function config_root() return vim.g.shoshinvim_config_root or vim.fn.stdpath('config') end
local function with(module, run)
  return function()
    local ok, m = pcall(require, module)
    if not ok then return vim.notify(module .. ' is not installed yet. Open ShoshinVim and download plugins.', vim.log.levels.WARN) end
    local done, err = pcall(run, m) -- For example Git status outside a Git repository.
    if not done then vim.notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.WARN) end
  end
end

-- Generated by ShoshinVim. Put manual changes in user.lua.
-- Plugins load when first needed. The other modules set each one up through on_load,
-- which runs as lazy.nvim loads it; setup errors are kept in M.errors.
local M = { errors = {}, setups = {} }
local function run(name, setup)
  local done, err = pcall(setup)
  if not done then
    M.errors[#M.errors + 1] = name .. ': ' .. tostring(err)
    vim.notify('ShoshinVim could not set up ' .. name .. ': ' .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
  end
end
-- configure is every plugin's config: its options, applied as lazy.nvim does, then the
-- setups registered for it, before the code that loaded it goes on.
function M.configure(plugin, opts)
  if plugin.opts ~= nil then require(require('lazy.core.loader').get_main(plugin)).setup(opts) end
  for _, setup in ipairs(M.setups[plugin.name] or {}) do run(plugin.name, setup) end
  M.setups[plugin.name] = nil
end
function M.on_load(name, setup)
  local ok, config = pcall(require, 'lazy.core.config')
  local plugin = ok and config.plugins[name]
  if not plugin then return end -- Not downloaded yet.
  if plugin._.loaded then return run(name, setup) end
  M.setups[name] = M.setups[name] or {}
  table.insert(M.setups[name], setup)
end
if vim.g.shoshinvim_probe then return M end
local base = vim.fn.stdpath('data') .. '/shoshinvim'
local lazy_path = base .. '/plugins/lazy.nvim'
if not vim.uv.fs_stat(lazy_path .. '/lua/lazy/init.lua') then
  lazy_path = base .. '/plugins/lazy' -- Earlier versions downloaded it here; downloading again moves it.
  if not vim.uv.fs_stat(lazy_path .. '/lua/lazy/init.lua') then return M end
end
vim.opt.rtp:prepend(lazy_path)
local specs = {}
local function installed(name, spec)
  spec.dir, spec.config = base .. '/plugins/' .. name, M.configure
  if vim.uv.fs_stat(spec.dir) then specs[#specs + 1] = spec end
end
